answer: Duplicate-bounty bond: each identity locks 70 credits on one dune plot and files a claim on the trellis lattice, one key per plot. Anyone proving a duplicate collects a 30-credit bounty from the fake's bond at the knoll checkpoint, where auditors replay claims; challengers sharing the accused's key burn both bonds. Each fake pays 85 (70 bond, 15 fee), so 1,000 fakes cost 85,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 85 once, keeps its bond.
